correct_completion: I would learn to play the guitar.
full_sentence: If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
acceptable_variants: I would practise the guitar every day.
I would start a new hobby.

options.text: I learned to play the guitar last year.
options.why_wrong: This describes a real past event. The second conditional talks about an imagined present or future situation.

options.text: I would learn to play the guitar.
I will learn to play the guitar next month.
options.why_wrong: This is a real plan for the future. The second conditional describes an imagined situation that is unlikely to happen.

options.text: I would have learned to play the guitar.
options.why_wrong: This uses the third conditional for an imagined past. The stem is about the present, so the second conditional is needed.

explanation: The second conditional describes an imagined present or future situation and its result. The if-clause uses the past simple, while the result clause uses would plus the base verb.
